name: PCD Collimation FAIL with Critical Indicators by sysid

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM pcd*, ct*
| WHERE collimation_status.keyword == "FAIL" OR TO_UPPER(indicator_severity.keyword) == "CRITICAL"
| EVAL is_pcd_fail = CASE(collimation_status.keyword == "FAIL", 1, 0)
| EVAL is_critical = CASE(TO_UPPER(indicator_severity.keyword) == "CRITICAL", 1, 0)
| STATS
    pcd_fail_count = SUM(is_pcd_fail),
    critical_count = SUM(is_critical),
    latest_event = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY sysid.keyword
| WHERE pcd_fail_count > 0 AND critical_count > 0
| RENAME `sysid.keyword` AS sysid
| KEEP sysid, pcd_fail_count, critical_count, latest_event
| SORT latest_event DESC
